description: Curated and source-derived retrieval checks. Allopathy labels verify exact product names or expected catalog text; Ayurveda labels verify CSV-derived record retrieval only. These cases do not validate clinical recommendations. Condition labels identify catalog rows whose Uses field contains the requested phrase; these are record-retrieval labels, not indications verified for clinical use. All current cases remain exploratory, not a held-out test set. New negative probes are explicitly split into development and test subsets; all original cases remain exploratory because prior retrieval results were viewed. New dev/test cases add out-of-sample negative probes, paraphrased condition phrases, ingredient, side-effect, manufacturer, multi-constraint and misspelled-name retrieval. The original positives remain exploratory. A fresh test-v2 set was authored after the first test run exposed safety and intersection issues; the inspected first test set is now assigned to dev. Test-v2 contains 15 negative and 6 positive cases and has not yet been evaluated.
